Stronger in both defense and offense, it can tear through basic armor when deflecting.|Inventory|TotK}} Mighty Lynel Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 44 |durability = 15 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Mighty Lynel Shield}} Mighty Lynel Shields are [[Shield]]s made by [[Lynel]]s. They have been reinforced by both armor and many blades. Compared to [[Lynel Shield]]s, they are stronger in both defense and offense, and they are capable of tearing through armor when deflecting (dealing 13 damage). They are part of the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s use these Shields, however [[White-Maned Lynel]]s in [[Master Mode]] will use these Shields. They become scarce as Lynels tier up, though the Blue-Maned Lynel in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]'s [[First Gatehouse]] will always stay the same, making it a permanent source of Mighty Lynel Shields. Being made of metal, Mighty Lynel Shields conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a thunderstorm, and will also sink if dropped in water. They can also be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_017" |Life = 15 |GuardPower = 44 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 17 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Mighty Lynel Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Mighty Lynel Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Mighty Lynel Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Mighty Lynel Sword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lynel Gear * Lynel Shield * Savage Lynel Shield * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Lynel Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
